d:
Iruvar Tamil Movie, Vennila Vennila Video Song, featuring featuring Mohanlal/Mohan Lal and Aishwarya Rai in lead roles.
Iruvar movie marked the debut of actress Aishwarya Rai. The movie was included in British Film Institute's 1000 Greatest Films of all time.
Release Date : 14 January 1997
Star Cast : Mohanlal, Aishwarya Rai, Tabu, Prakash Raj, Gautami/Gouthami, Revathi, Nassar/Nasser
Director : Mani Ratnam
Producers : Mani Ratnam, G Srinivasan
Music : A R Rahman
Cinematography : Santosh Sivan
